overview: This batch finalizes the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence check for the 5,500-tick milestone, and establishing the final ascension protocol for colonist psychology. All tasks are atomic, self-contained, and require zero cascading header dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
acceptance_criteria: StateHasher produces identical 64-bit hashes for identical simulation states across 1000 runs.
Zero heap allocations during hashing process.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Guarantees 100% reproducible saves, eliminating 'ghost' desyncs in long-running campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence Check for 5,500-Tick Milestone
acceptance_criteria: Convergence detected within 100 ticks of stabilization.
No dynamic memory allocation in Update or IsConverged.
Handles edge case of count < kWindowSize correctly.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster resolution of physics simulations, reducing perceived lag in endgame scenarios.

tasks.title: Finalize Colonist Psychology Ascension Protocol
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot packs into a single 32-bit integer without loss of precision for standard campaign lengths.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instantaneous load times for endgame states, providing a seamless conclusion to the campaign.
